<h1 id="sanguine-crawlers" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Sanguine Crawlers</nowiki></h1>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sanguine_crawler <nowiki>Sanguine crawlers</nowiki>]<nowiki> are a low level Slayer </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> mob found on top of the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Blighted_Cave <nowiki>Blighted Cave</nowiki>]<nowiki>, located in Havenhythe. They are mainly killed for the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_collection_log#Havenhythe <nowiki>Havenhythe collection log</nowiki>]<nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 28</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 54.2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~1500 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~81.3k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Vampyrism_gloves <nowiki>Vampyrism gloves</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1487224784428335255.png?v=1" alt="vampyrismgloves" title="vampyrismgloves" kind="icon" /></p>

<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>

<h3 id="useful-items-and-unlocks"><nowiki>Useful Items and Unlocks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_fairy_ring <nowiki>Portable fairy ring</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799722780360704.png?v=1" alt="portablefairyring" title="portablefairyring" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Teleport to </nowiki><code></code><nowiki>BKS</nowiki><code></code><nowiki> and run northeast.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Antisanguine <nowiki>Antisanguine</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Mitigates the damage of the </nowiki><code></code><nowiki>schluurp</nowiki><code></code><nowiki> mechanic if needed.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Havensilver_weapons <nowiki>Havensilver weapons</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Anything else deals reduced damage, may be used if downgrading gear.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Oldak_coil <nowiki>Oldak coil</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Make sure to have the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop#Rewards <nowiki>Restocking Cannon</nowiki>]<nowiki> ability unlocked.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Access to boss portals
    • Teleporting to Silverquill, the Dreadhog is the quickest way to reach the Blighted Cave.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><ins><nowiki>Location and How to Get there</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Sanguine crawlers can be fought on top of the Blighted Cave, located in Havenhythe.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Blighted Cave</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/hZs8OVaOEw.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Teleport to Silverquill, the Dreadhog via a boss portal, exit the cave and head north.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• May alternatively use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799722780360704.png?v=1" alt="portablefairyring" title="portablefairyring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and teleport to </nowiki><code><nowiki>BKS</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎then run northeast.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Place your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as shown above, your character will constantly be moving.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-melee"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Melee</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Before loading your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and starting the session, check the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you will need extra prayer sustain, use prayer potion drops as needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
